facts.fact: 1. Rena 意识到要命的事实：Kieran 找到一个长得像前任的陌生人，脑内已推演 aftermath——他会像对 Josiah 那样把她也冰封吗？
facts.anchor: Kieran’s found somebody who looks like his ex

facts.fact: 2. 站姿论：Kieran 站在世界里像随时要讲笑话，而 Josiah 与 Not-Josiah 都像十秒后就要心脏病发——熟悉感的来源。
facts.anchor: ten seconds from a heart attack

facts.fact: 3. Lucas 劝「他不是你的责任」「让他 crash and burn」，Rena 反击 low blow「What, like I did last year?」；她心里说 Lucas 缺了太多故事章节，无法怪他不懂筹码。
facts.anchor: how many chapters he’s missing from the story

facts.fact: 4. Josiah 的最后短信（Is Kieran ok? / Did I do something / Wtf Rena / Don’t lie to me）不是谎言能对上的：Kieran 连她都没告诉——她曾坐在他紧闭的卧室门外哀求到几乎哭出来。
facts.anchor: sat outside his closed bedroom door

facts.fact: 5. 去年夏天 country club 背景：Kieran 以「从内部瓦解体制」为由妥协参加（顺带吐槽 gay people 为零）；Rena 本意是 tennis+看住他。
facts.anchor: Do you know how many gay people will be there? Zero.

facts.fact: 6. Rena 在泳池边无聊到窒息，Kieran 却在跟 Lucas 的表亲、球场 cart jockey Josiah 恋爱；四人组 cider/洒水器/喜剧夜，她差点相信自己没失去过他。
7. 七月某晚 Kieran 低语 He’s perfect. You don’t understand.，接着 I think I— 再没说完：远处一声脆响的关门，Josiah 从场那边喊他名字。
facts.anchor: running his fingers over the neatly trimmed grass

facts.fact: 8. Rena 决定不 run interference：Kieran 毕生喧闹，唯独愤怒时寂静，她受不了那种频率的安静再对准她一次——Not again.
facts.anchor: that frequency of quiet directed straight at her
